title: Mark Walter agrees to sell Lakers to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for $12.5 billion
text:
Mark Walter agrees to sell Lakers to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for $12.5 billion
Mark Walter has agreed on Aug. 12 to sell the Los Angeles Lakers to businessmen Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for a $12.5 billion valuation, marking the second sale of the team in as many years.
The sale is notable because Walter purchased the team only a year ago and was in the process of making significant changes within the organization. According to Ramona Shelburne of ESPN, "Josh Kushner and Bob Iger were part of a group that was bidding on a new expansion franchise in Las Vegas. The price for Las Vegas was climbing up into the stratosphere and at one point they kind of looked at each other and said, ‘Why are we going so hard for an expansion franchise without checking to see if a team like the Los Angeles Lakers is open?’ They both live in L.A., I think Josh has a house in Malibu and Bob has a house in Brentwood. They’re huge sports fans, NBA fans… I think they just placed a call to see if before they move forward with, I don’t know the number what it was on Vegas, but let’s say it was $10 billion,"
Shelburne continued: "Why are we going more than that for an expansion franchise when the Lakers just sold for $10 billion for a brand and a team that already exists and is iconic. They called Mark Walter on Sunday and asked if he would consider it. He had a day or two to decide. It’s just an incredible business opportunity, I don’t think he was looking to sell, but it was something he had to look at because of how much money was involved. This is an absolutely earth shatter number at $12.5 billion.”
It has also been reported that some of Walter’s other companies are under investigation for potential financial improprieties, which may have influenced his decision regarding this transaction.
Iger and Kushner will become only the third ownership group since the Buss family sold their stake in the Lakers. It remains uncertain whether they will continue with Walter's organizational changes or implement their own direction moving forward.
Walter initially purchased the Lakers in 2025 at a then-record valuation of $10 billion; selling now at $12.5 billion sets another record for North American professional sports franchises.
